shortDescription: Module to Add/Delete BIG-IP Next Instances onto Central Manager

options.name: accept_untrusted
options.description: Option to enable/disable untrusted certificates from discovered BIG-IP Next instances.

options.name: device_ip
options.description: The ip address of the BIG-IP Next instance to discover and add under CM management.

options.name: device_password
options.description: The administrator password on the target BIG-IP Next instance.

options.name: device_port
options.description: The port on which CM can communicate with the BIG-IP Next instance.

options.name: device_user
options.description: The administrator username on the target BIG-IP Next instance.

options.name: force
options.description: When C(true), re-discovers managed existing BIG-IP Next instance by removing adding the device with the given C(device_ip). When C(false), no device is added if a device with the same C(device_ip) exists.

options.name: mgmt_password
options.description: The password the CM uses to manage the target BIG-IP Next instance. Parameter required when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: mgmt_user
options.description: The username the CM uses to manage the target BIG-IP Next instance. Parameter required when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the BIG-IP Next instance is discovered and added under CM management. When C(absent), ensures the BIG-IP Next instance is removed from CM management.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time to wait for the discover task to finish, in seconds. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.
